About this collection

Every wallpaper in here is a personal pick. The collection follows my taste rather than trying to have everything, so some of your favorites are bound to be missing.

If there is a wallpaper you want to see here, send it in on the Submissions tab. I look at every one, and the ones that fit get added.

Submit a wallpaper

Found one that belongs here? Send it my way. I look at every submission myself, and the ones that fit get added to the gallery.

Sending is not switched on yet, so submissions are saved on this computer for now.

What fits

  • Anime art, SFW only
  • At least 1280 pixels wide, wider than it is tall
  • A link to the original post or the image itself

      aerochan

      Made by Aozora

      I spent way too long hunting for good anime wallpapers. They were spread across a dozen sites, half the links were dead, and the ones that worked were often tiny or stretched. So I gathered the ones I liked into one place, sorted them, and made them easy to grab. This is for anyone who has been through the same hunt.

      Everything here is SFW. Suggestive tags are filtered out and every thumbnail was checked by eye. If one still slips through, hover it and press Hide.

      Downloads come through the wsrv.nl image relay, since Konachan and Safebooru block downloads from other pages. JPEGs are re-saved at 95% quality, so use Original image when you want the exact file.

      Music: “Frutiger aero/eco/aqua core 🐬🐠💦🫧🌱”, a Spotify playlist by Ini 🐠.
